# T-2: Migrate legacy repair state

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
repairBaseline を持つ active flow の v2 artifact を guarded migration で v3 と migration record に置換し、test-execute へ復帰させる。

## Acceptance Criteria
- Migration record stores runId, specPath, sourceVersion, targetVersion, invalidated artifact paths, and resetStep.
- Successful migration invalidates downstream evidence and makes test-execute in_progress without manual artifact mutation.
- A failed migration preserves the existing manifest and downstream evidence.

## Implementation Notes
impl-repair-artifacts の existing lock, atomic write, issue log, and FlowManager mutation patternsを利用する。baseline authority conflict は fail closed のままにする。

## Test Strategy
unit tests: baseline-bearing state migration, record fields, invalidation/state transition, failure preservation.
